summary: Migrate standalone roles into the collection's roles/ directory, renaming them without hyphens and switching playbooks to FQCNs. A role uses up to seven standard directories (defaults, files, handlers, meta, tasks, templates, vars, plus tests), needs at least one, and each has a main.yml.
questions: What is the directory structure of an Ansible role?
Can a role name contain hyphens in a collection?
